title: Trace relation proven to be a partial order at Heathrow

tellings.quote: so I took it to Jayton I said look Jayton I think this thing is a logic technically a partial order and he said Don it's too pretty to be true and he had to fly somewhere So he got to Heathrow and decided to check it and he proved it.

plain: A mathematical idea called the trace relation was proven to be a partial order, a precise kind of logical ordering, by a colleague waiting at London's Heathrow airport. That is the account of the researcher Don Hoffman, who says he brought the idea to his colleague Jayton Posash. Posash told him "Don, it's too pretty to be true," then checked it at Heathrow on his way to a flight and proved it.
